description: The user's own support issues — bug reports and questions they or their agents (agent keys and app connections) sent R3 — newest first, with status, date, the project and whether an agent filed it (and which), each with its link. It shows whether a fault is already reported, before r3_bug_report would file it twice. Needs the support:write right.

limit.description: How many to return, newest first (default 20).

name: r3_bug_reports_mine

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: List the bug reports the user has filed
